items: A mother is a woman who has a child.
A father is a man who has a child.
A sister is a girl in your family.
A brother is a boy in your family.
A grandmother is the mother of your parent.
A grandfather is the father of your parent.
A baby is a very young child.
A daughter is a girl who is someone's child.
A son is a boy who is someone's child.
Children are the sons and daughters in a family.
